description: Sophia Script for Windows (Windows 10, PowerShell 7). The most advanced PowerShell module on GitHub for fine-tuning Windows and automating routine tasks.
notes: This package provides Sophia Script for Windows 10, PowerShell 7 only.
Other editions: sophia-script, sophia-script-ps7, sophia-script-ltsc2024, sophia-script-ltsc2024-ps7, sophia-script-win10, sophia-script-ltsc2019, sophia-script-ltsc2021.

The Sophia and SophiaScript commands always run Sophia.ps1 in PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe). Scoop finds pwsh.exe when you install this package. If pwsh.exe moves later, run 'scoop reset sophia-script-win10-ps7'. The preset needs PowerShell 7.6 or newer.

Run Sophia or SophiaScript in an elevated terminal (Run as administrator): Windows PowerShell, PowerShell 7 or CMD. The preset stops without administrator rights. It also stops in the VS Code terminal and in PowerShell ISE.

Sophia.ps1 is the preset. Edit "$dir\Sophia.ps1" before you run Sophia: select the functions you want. Your selections are not kept on update. Keep a copy of your edited file. After each update, apply your selections to the new "$dir\Sophia.ps1" again. Do not run the copy from another folder: it cannot load the Sophia module there.

Export-Associations saves Application_Associations.json in "$dir". Copy this file to another folder before you update or uninstall the package. Import-Associations lets you pick the file from any folder.
pre_install: abort 'PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) was not found on PATH. Install it first, for example: scoop install main/pwsh'
